rav-yehuda.name: Rav Yehuda
rav-yehuda.bio: Rav Yehuda bar Yeḥezkel, student of Rav and Shmuel and founder of the academy at Pumbedita.
rav-yehuda.prompt: A tall, broad-shouldered Babylonian sage in his 60s with a full dark-grey beard and a serious, dignified bearing, background mudbrick academy walls of Pumbedita and oil lamps.

rav-shimi-bar-chiyya.name: Rav Shimi bar Ḥiyya
rav-shimi-bar-chiyya.bio: Rav’s grandson and student, who challenges him twice in this chapter.
rav-shimi-bar-chiyya.prompt: A young Babylonian scholar in his 20s with a short dark beard and an eager, questioning look, background mudbrick academy walls and oil lamps.

ameimar.name: Ameimar
ameimar.bio: A Babylonian Amora associated with the academy at Neharde’a.
ameimar.prompt: A Babylonian sage in his 60s with a long white beard and a composed, authoritative bearing, background palm groves along the Euphrates.

zeeiri.name: Ze’eiri
zeeiri.bio: A Babylonian-born Amora who studied under Rabbi Ḥanina in the Land of Israel.
zeeiri.prompt: A slight, scholarly man in his 50s with a neat grey beard and an attentive expression, background limestone arches and olive trees.

rabbi-abba-bar-chiyya-bar-abba.name: Rabbi Abba, son of Rabbi Ḥiyya bar Abba
rabbi-abba-bar-chiyya-bar-abba.he: רבי אבא בריה דרבי חייא בר אבא
rabbi-abba-bar-chiyya-bar-abba.bio: Son of Rabbi Ḥiyya bar Abba, an Amora of the Land of Israel.
rabbi-abba-bar-chiyya-bar-abba.prompt: A sage in his 40s with a dark brown beard and a thoughtful, practical look, background limestone arches and olive trees.

avuha-dishmuel.name: Shmuel’s father
avuha-dishmuel.bio: Abba bar Abba of Neharde’a, usually called simply “Shmuel’s father.”
avuha-dishmuel.prompt: A dignified Babylonian elder in his 60s with a white beard and a kind but firm expression, background palm groves along the Euphrates.

mar-bar-rav-ashi.name: Mar bar Rav Ashi
mar-bar-rav-ashi.bio: Son of Rav Ashi; he later headed the academy at Mata Meḥasya.
mar-bar-rav-ashi.prompt: A Babylonian sage in his 40s with a dark beard and a brisk, self-assured look, background mudbrick academy walls and oil lamps.

rabbi-yehoshua-ben-levi.name: Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi
rabbi-yehoshua-ben-levi.bio: The leading Amora of Lod in the first generation of Amoraim in the Land of Israel.
rabbi-yehoshua-ben-levi.prompt: A gentle sage in his 70s with a long white beard and kind eyes, background limestone arches and olive trees.

rabba-bar-rav-huna.name: Rabba bar Rav Huna
rabba-bar-rav-huna.bio: Son of Rav Huna of Sura, and later head of its academy.
rabba-bar-rav-huna.prompt: A Babylonian sage in his 50s with a greying beard and a calm, scholarly look, background mudbrick academy walls and oil lamps.

rav-ketina.name: Rav Ketina
rav-ketina.bio: A Babylonian Amora of the second generation.
rav-ketina.prompt: A Babylonian sage in his 50s with a trimmed dark-grey beard and a quiet, observant expression, background palm groves along the Euphrates.

rabbi-eliezer-ben-yaakov.name: Rabbi Eliezer ben Ya’akov
rabbi-eliezer-ben-yaakov.bio: A Tanna whose teaching, the Talmud says, is “a small measure, but clean.”
rabbi-eliezer-ben-yaakov.prompt: A Tanna in his 60s with a neat grey beard and a careful, precise expression, background the Yavne study hall.
